People were told to find other ways to travel.

37c935d5eda05860ed18f77020ad0b5ad9add2f7.title: The Clever Fox and the Little Bird

questions.question: Who is this story about?
questions.explanation: The title tells us the story is about a clever fox and a little bird.

questions.question: What kind of animal is the fox?
questions.explanation: The title says the fox is clever, which means he is smart.

questions.question: What size is the bird in the title?
questions.explanation: The title calls the bird a little bird.

questions.question: Where do birds usually fly?
questions.explanation: Birds use their wings to fly high up in the sky.

questions.question: What does a clever animal do?
questions.explanation: Being clever means you are good at thinking of smart ideas.
